caption: One click travels down the stack: the UI builds the request, the wallet signs it, the node receives it over JSON-RPC, and the contract at its address runs the bytecode. Notice that the wallet, not the page, holds the key.

spec.title: DApp call path
spec.aria: A user clicks a DApp UI, the wallet signs the request, an RPC node receives it over JSON-RPC, and the call reaches the contract stored at its address.
